summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on analyzing raw device traffic data from a buffer table. Initially, the goal was to establish a baseline count of unique routers and total packets over time.

[me] provided a query to calculate counts for 600 seconds (10 minutes) prior to the current time. This established an initial baseline.

Later, [p1] requested a more detailed analysis: the count of unique boxes and total packets aggregated into five-minute intervals for the day. [me] executed this query, providing a comprehensive dataset showing traffic metrics from 10:00 AM to 4:75 PM (the last recorded interval).

The data review was conducted to check for any potential drops or anomalies in the raw device stream.
decisions: A detailed five-minute aggregation of unique box counts and total packets from `raw_devices_seen_buffer` was successfully generated.
action_items: The data analysis completed by [me] will be used to monitor the MQTT broker deployment and ensure traffic stability.
